steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ event summary without searching or recreating the event.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the evaluation-time flow.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where Edit Evaluation Time is available.
Open Edit Evaluation Time, increase the evaluation duration by 30 minutes, save it, and verify the new end equals the previous end plus 30 minutes.
